notes.title: Patch notes 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Updates in this patch:

The card descriptions have been simplified, making them easier to understand at a glance with clear icons.

There is now an explanation of each part of the card when you hover it. This can be turned off with the icon on the card, if you don't like it.

There was an issue with the pause menu when playing with controller, which has been resolved

The game should now be less likely to crash unexpectedly

When you start dragging card, the wrong (X) was shown sometimes - this is now fixed

Target arrow used to get stuck on screen, which is no longer the case

You are now reminded when you have a new plushie

The Undo button has been moved in the end of encounter screen, to decrease risk of clicking it accidentally

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.05
notes.notes:
The effect of base cards (heal, deal, block, prep) can now be clearly seen in the top part of the cards
 If you feel like the HP bars are too cuttered, there's now a button to hide the icons 
 Combo now has the correct hover text, and is described in the legend
 "Paint into a corner" now only costs 1 energy
 Assistants can now cast curse cards on activists
 Language will now be determined based on OS on first opening the game
 Description for how Attention works is now in the tutorial, and the Legend
 Curse cards put into opponent decks are now properly cleared out after they are cast
 You can no longer get the 20 block achievement due to an opponent stacking Block (sorry)

notes.title: Patch notes v 1.1.04
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in loading screen after failing an encounter, if you play with a controller
 Fixed issue where you could press things behind intro cinematic when starting a new game (also when using controller)
 Going back/forward in dialogue now displays the same activist as talking
 Monsters could in some cases get stuck throwing the same card over and over again. Should no longer be happening!
 In upgrade screen, the cards that cannot be upgraded will now be visible but blocked to avoid confusion. Also some cards previously not upgradable can now be upgraded
 Some plushies' effects were not disabled when stolen, so I fixed that

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.03
notes.notes:
The X overlay no longer remains after the end of the encounter, which could look confusing when entering the next one


 Play speed is now reset at the end of encounter, meaning if you speed up and encounter ends on opponent's turn you will no longer have a SPEEDY wanderbeast in the encounter map (sorry)


 The outro audio should now be in synch with the text


 There is not a warning before the final encounter that save will be wiped if you complete the game 

 Pixie legs are now just a little less stiff

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.02
notes.notes:
Fixed issue where the encounter map items remained on top of world map
 Controller joystick motions should be a little smoother when selecting cards and monsters

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.01
notes.notes:
Changes in this version are mostly ficused on UX, and include:

 The possible targets for each card has been made a little more clear, with additional arrows and (X) over unavailable characters
 The currently selected card is now a bit more clear, with an arrow pointing at it. This is especially useful when playing with a controller!
 The prompt to select a target when you have chosen a card is anow a little more clear
 Settings menu should now be easier to navigate with a controller
 The Legend can now only be opened in relevant menus, as to not be confusing
 You can no longer open the Plushie assignment panel with a controller before you have any, as to be less confusing
 The functionality of Prep has been made a little more clear (new icon, honing object) - however I intend to keep working on this 


What should I focus on next? LMK!

/A

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is available now!
notes.notes:
The first content/feature update for KreatureKind is now live!


 You can now encounter a Nekomata and a Pixie
 There is now a log in the dialogues, which allows you to go back and read transcripts of previous dialogues
 By popular demand, the game now has a screenshot mode! Access it with TAB on the keyboard


I'm planning to add more improvements over time, so let me know what you want to see next on Discord!

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.0
notes.notes:
You can now encounter a Nekomata and a Pixie
 There is now a log in the dialogues, which allows you to go back and read transcripts of previous dialogues
 By popular demand, the game now has a screenshot mode! Access it with TAB on the keyboard

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.26
notes.notes:
Changed culturally insensitive character name
 Fixed mipmap issue with Wanderbeast in maps

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.25
notes.notes:
When you're playing with controller, there is now a handy arrow which makes it more clear which opponent/activist you're targeting with a card
 Fixed an issue where Luca's plushies didn't work if he was unlocked before Finley (long story)
 Fixed issue where the hover effect on HP bars stuck around after a card was cast with controller
 The next node in the encounter map should now be seleted for you when you use a controller
 Fixed issue where VO volume sometimes didn't load properly
 To make it more clear when you can unlock a new activist, the Encounter node is now turned off when it's unavailable, and has a NEW marker when you can go it it

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.24
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the game didn't find the last plushie (because of another one that's not currently in use)
 Fixed an issue where base cards could get stuck in limbo - not unlocked, and not showing up at the Merchant

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.23
notes.notes:
I have heard you! You can now change the VO volume separately from SFX
 There was an issue with the 7 plushie achievement, which has now been fixed
 In rare occasions, the dialogue UI could get stuck at the bottom of the screen. It has been fixed
 Carnival music should no longer overstay its welcome
 You can no longer open the currently unused dialogue log with controller
 Mummy now has a voice
 Gelatine cubold has gotten some new materials

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.21
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where achievements didn't unlock properly when getting full standing with some factions (most notably Cooks). If you should have recieved the achievement but didn't, you will get it when you start the game with v 1.0.21 or later.
 Achievements should now pop up right away, not just when you quit the game.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.19
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the player could get blocked from progressing when giving up from a DoT on opponent's turn
 The tutorial checks on the left side of screen should now look correct in all languages
 Fixed localization issues in activist selection screen
 Fixed localization issues in merchant/home panel
 Fixed small issue where there could be a font error in world map when switching languages
 Made sure circus music doesn't keep playing in encounter map when unlocking activist
 Fixed issue where locked characters sometimes showed up as unlocked in activist selection screen
 Fixed small color issue on the Wendigo back arm, holding phone
 Made sure the middle of the screen arrow button works as intended
 Made sure the middle of the screen arrow button disappears when casting activist card with slots
 There should no longer be a sound when gaining 0 block from plushie
 Put music visualizer back in

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.18
notes.notes: Accidentally created new bugs with the fix to card infusion, so I fixed those :)

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.17
notes.notes:
Made sure settings save even before choosing a save slot
 If you lose the encounter when trying to recruit an activist, they should no longer be unlocked anyway
 Improved flow when choosing not to use an Ability card with slots. It should now be more clear how they work and you can return them and the infused cards easily to hand
 Rebalanced "HoT"/"DoT" cards
 Made tutorial encounters slightly easier
 Made sure clouds don't get stuck overhead when an activist gives up
 Resetting a save now resets which opponents you have talked to properly
 Fixed visual issue with end of encounter screen backgrounds
 Fixed visual issue with Mitra's coat
 Increased text border size (it had been decreased due to some font changes)

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.15
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the player was blocked from progressing when losing an encounter with controller
